title: Tor criterion for flatness of the opcycles of a flat complex
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, let P^\bullet be a cochain complex [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] of flat A-modules [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and let a be an integer. If for every A-module N the tensor complex P^\bullet\otimes_A N [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] is exact in degree a-1, then the cokernel P^a/\operatorname{im}(d^{a-1}) is a flat A-module [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules].
